questions.question: What are the six initial principles in NASA's ethical AI framework?
questions.operator_query: Fair Explainable Transparent Accountable Secure Safe Human-Centric Societally Beneficial Scientifically Ethically Robust
questions.reference_answer: Fair; Explainable and Transparent; Accountable; Secure and Safe; Human-Centric and Societally Beneficial; Scientifically and Ethically Robust.

variants: Fair. AI systems must include considerations regarding how to treat people
Explainable and Transparent. Solutions must clearly state if, when, and how an AI system is involved
Accountable. Organizations and individuals must be accountable for the systems they create
Secure and Safe. AI systems must respect privacy and do no harm
Human-Centric and Societally Beneficial. AI systems must obey human legal systems
AI systems must be Scientifically and Ethically Robust

source_fitness.rationale: Exact NASA NTRS technical memorandum containing the declared framework.
